capabilities: Attach notes, selections, text files, and images as chat context
Stream Markdown responses and resume, search, rename, or fork saved conversations
Approve or deny file and shell tool requests under per-provider permission modes
Run a read-only review of uncommitted Git changes
Export conversations or latest answers to vault notes
disambiguation: Despite the name, it is not an official OpenAI product and chats with both Codex and Claude Code CLIs.
extras: Warns that the plugin performs filesystem access, child-process execution, and bundled SDK dynamic code generation, and is not a complete security boundary. Unofficial and independent of OpenAI, Anthropic, and Obsidian. Codex app-server uses experimental APIs, so CLI/SDK changes may require plugin updates.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run an AI coding agent chat from inside the app using your existing CLI installation and provider login.

relations.evidence: A native, dockable Obsidian desktop chat for Codex CLI or Claude Code CLI, using your installed executable
using your installed executable and existing provider login

requires.name: Codex CLI or Claude Code CLI installed and authenticated
Provider account login via the CLI

summary: Dockable chat panel for a locally installed Codex CLI or Claude Code CLI, with note attachments, streamed Markdown, tool approvals, and saved sessions.
